race.comment: READY FOR AIMEE (1) is hard to ignore after putting two on the bounce in style. The form around her measures right up and she keeps a 2kg claimer on to help aid the big weight. Hat-trick inbound. SHREDDED (4) is the clear danger after chasing RFA into second last time. Meets the winner with a 2kg swing here which can well and truly turn the tables. SAXON SPIRIT (13) looks a handy filly set to return for the Munce camp. Was last seen finishing midfield in LR company back in June, and her two recent trials suggest she's come on nicely during the break. Not taking lightly. SHORTCUT (6) only got clear room late when resuming and knuckled down strongly when through. Will relish the rise in trip second-up and give this a shake with even luck. LEBANESE (3) is in good touch after leading pillar-to-post here last time. Expect Lang to push forward on her again and give them something to catch.
